description: This PHP source file defines a class `Image_Graph_Marker_Array` that manages a sequence (array) of marker objects for use in graph rendering, allowing multiple markers to be added and iterated sequentially for data point visualization. It also includes licensing, author, and dependency information.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Array
classes.description: A class for managing a sequential array of marker objects in graph rendering, enabling the addition and sequential drawing of different markers for data points.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a marker object to the internal marker array, accepting objects of type 'Image_Graph_Element' and calling the parent add method if applicable.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the current marker at specified (x, y) position, cycling through the marker array sequentially.
